pages.title: Stability
pages.text: $(thing)Stability$()$(br2)A ball in a bowl comes back when pushed; a ball on a hill does not. Whether a fixed point is a bowl or a hill decides everything. Unlocks the Stability Margin.

$(thing)Insight$(): 80$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Fixed Points, Eigenvalues.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 2 Rate Table.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): Near a fixed point a disturbance x grows or shrinks as dx/dt = λx. Write the disturbance X after a time t, starting from x.
